reviews.comment: Boring lecturer and a bit anal about the attendance quizzes, which could be anywhere from 100% free to nobody knowing what's going on.

This class is really what you make of it; it is easy but if you're willing to pay attention Prof. Sarin spends a lot of time actually teaching you things on top of the slides rather than just the slides. Homeworks are easy and quizzes are fine if you pay attention (unlike me) though they're weighed a good amount. Can be boring, but I'd recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: vivek is really nice and this class is not bad but needing to stay the entire class until 6:45 PM for pop quizzes is troublesome :(

Class is not that difficult. Lectures are pretty boring as he tends to talk about a topic for a little too long and over-explain it. In-lecture quizzes which you have to be there to get credit for it. Quizzes are fairly easy if you pay a little attention to lectures. No exams. HW assignments aren't that bad, but they can be pretty vague at times.

Detailed lectures and goes in-depth on parallel computing concepts. Cares a lot about the quality of teaching and overall a very pleasant experience. The course contains in-class quizzes so attendance is mandatory. Assignments are easy to understand as he goes over them in class as it is released.

Dr. Sarin is a good professor and it is clear that he knows a lot about the subjects he teaches. He is patient and understanding. The 435 class in particular is extremely easy. Moderate assignment difficulty and easy quizzes. Attendance is mandatory (to take the quizzes). You can learn as much or as little according to the effort you put in.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is awesome. He did so much heavy lifting in class and I learned a lot while doing the projects. He actually teaches stuff in his class and does not read the slides. He cares about the students and is very reasonable. If you are interested in parallel computing and HPC, do not think twice. We did Open MP, Open MPI and CUDA.
Sarin is a decent prof. He definitely makes you work for your grade but with hard work should come a decent grade. He's pretty quirky but overall a nice guy.

He is a solid choice for 222. His lectures can be a bit boring but his lecture notes help in understanding. The tests are hit or miss. Sometimes they are really easy and other times they are kinda hard. He lets as use a cheat sheet on exams. There is an optional final to replace lowest grade. Should be a very doable A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Good professor, always ready to help. Teaches the concepts in a easy to understand way :)Tests aren't too hard.
Very tough, teaches at graduate-level.  Assigns grades based on the class average.  Very helpful outside of class.
